reports.headline: Unusual Distance Reported Along the {dir_cap}ern Road
reports.body: Several travelers claim the old watchtower {dir} of the village {dist} appears much closer than it actually is. {name} reportedly walked toward it for nearly an hour without getting any closer. Others insist they have seen a figure standing beside the tower after dark, although nobody has been found there.

reports.headline: The Watchtower That Will Not Come Closer
reports.body: {name} set out at dusk for the old watchtower {dir} of here {dist} and came back at dawn, swearing {they} had walked all night and the tower had stayed exactly the same size. Children say a tall figure stands beside it at night, looking at the village, and that it has no eyes.
